DepositProcessorOnly(address,address).details: Only the deposit processor is able to call the function.

ManagerOnly(address,address).details: Only `manager` has a privilege, but the `sender` was provided.

params.manager: Required sender address as a manager.

OwnerOnly(address,address).details: Only `owner` has a privilege, but the `sender` was provided.

params.owner: Required sender address as an owner.

params.numValues1: Number of values in a first array.
params.numValues2: Number of values in a second array.

ZeroValue().details: Zero value when it has to be different from zero.

calculateStakingIncentives(uint256,uint2.details: Calculates staking incentives for a specific staking target.

params.bridgingDecimals: Number of supported token decimals able to be transferred across the bridge.
params.stakingTarget: Staking target corresponding to the chain Id.

returns.lastClaimedEpoch: Last claimed epoch number (not included in claiming).
returns.totalReturnAmount: Total return amount across all the claimed epochs.
returns.totalStakingIncentive: Total staking incentive across all the claimed epochs.

changeStakingParams(uint256,uint256).details: Changes staking params by the DAO.

params._maxNumClaimingEpochs: Maximum number of epochs to claim staking incentives for.
params._maxNumStakingTargets: Maximum number of staking targets available to claim for on a single chain Id.

claimOwnerIncentives(uint256[],uint256[].details: Claims incentives for the owner of components / agents.

params.unitIds: Set of corresponding unit Ids where account is the owner.

claimStakingIncentives(uint256,uint256,b.details: Claims staking incentives for a specific staking target.

params.bridgePayload: Bridge payload necessary (if required) for a specific bridge relayer.
params.stakingTarget: Staking target corresponding to the chain Id.

claimStakingIncentivesBatch(uint256,uint.details: Claims staking incentives for sets staking targets corresponding to a set of chain Ids.

params.bridgePayloads: Set of bridge payloads (if) necessary for a specific bridge relayer depending on chain Id.
params.stakingTargets: Set of staking target addresses corresponding to each chain Id.
params.valueAmounts: Set of value amounts required to provide to some of the bridges.

retain().details: Retains staking incentives according to the retainer address to return it back to the staking inflation.

setDepositProcessorChainIds(address[],ui.details: Sets deposit processor contracts addresses and L2 chain Ids.

params.chainIds: Set of corresponding L2 chain Ids.
params.depositProcessors: Set of deposit processor contract addresses on L1.

syncWithheldAmount(uint256,uint256,bytes.details: Syncs the withheld token amount according to the data received from L2.

params.batchHash: Unique batch hash for each message transfer.
params.chainId: L2 chain Id the withheld amount data is communicated from.

syncWithheldAmountMaintenance(uint256,ui.details: Syncs the withheld amount manually by the DAO in order to restore the data that was not delivered from L2.

params.amount: Withheld amount that was not delivered from L2.
params.batchHash: Unique batch hash for each message transfer.

devdoc.title: Dispenser - Smart contract for distributing incentives

calculateStakingIncentives(uint256,uint2.notice: Call this function via staticcall in order not to write in the nominee checkpoint map.

claimOwnerIncentives(uint256[],uint256[].notice: `msg.sender` must be the owner of components / agents they are passing, otherwise the function will revert.If not all `unitIds` belonging to `msg.sender` were provided, they will be untouched and keep accumulating.

claimStakingIncentivesBatch(uint256,uint.notice: Mind the gas spending depending on the max number of numChains * numTargetsPerChain * numEpochs to claim.         Also note that in order to avoid duplicates, there is a requirement for a strict ascending order         of chain Ids and stakingTargets.

removeNominee(bytes32).notice: The staking contract nominee cannot be removed starting from one week before the end of epoch.         Since the epoch end time is unknown and the nominee removal is applied in the following week,         it is prohibited to remove nominee one week before the foreseen epoch end to correctly reflect         the removal epoch number.         If the staking contract nominee must not get incentives in the ongoing ending epoch as well,         the DAO is advised to use the removeInstance() function in the corresponding StakingFactory contract.

setDepositProcessorChainIds(address[],ui.notice: It is the contract owner responsibility to set correct L1 deposit processor contracts         and corresponding supported L2 chain Ids.

syncWithheldAmount(uint256,uint256,bytes.notice: Only a corresponding chain Id deposit processor is able to communicate the withheld amount data.         Note that by design only a normalized withheld amount is delivered from L2.

syncWithheldAmountMaintenance(uint256,ui.notice: The parameters here must correspond to the exact data failed to be delivered (amount, batch).         The possible bridge failure scenario that requires to act via the DAO vote includes:         - Message from L2 to L1 fails: need to call this function.
